ourStory.body: KINETIX was born from a simple desire — to give everyone the chance to try on shoes and find the pair that truly fits before committing to buy.
ourStory.quote: Because we believe the right shoe will take you further than you've ever gone before.

items.q: How many days can I rent and what is the price?
items.a: Kinetix offers 3 packages: 1 day, 3 days, and 7 days. Starting at ฿200/day depending on the model, plus a 20% retail price deposit refunded after shoe inspection.

items.q: How is delivery handled and when will I receive it?
items.a: Kinetix delivers Door-to-Door the next day (D+1) before noon. Orders accepted 24/7. Rental period starts from 12:00 PM on the delivery day.
Cancellations are only accepted before 23:59 on the order date for a full refund. If you need to change size, cancel and re-order before 23:59.

items.q: When will my deposit be refunded?
items.a: Grade A/B: Full refund within 1 business day. Grade C/D: 48hr dispute window then partial refund. Grade E (lost): No refund + full retail price charged. Credit card via Omise 3–5 business days.

items.q: Can I check the shoe condition before receiving?
items.a: Yes! Every pair shows its current grade (A–D) with condition notes before you order, and you'll see the grade with photo evidence after returning.

items.q: What happens if I refuse to accept delivery?
items.a: Order is cancelled with a full refund, but your account records a reject count. 2nd time: Warning. 3rd time: Account may be temporarily suspended.
3 options: Credit/Debit card, PromptPay, and Bank Transfer — via Omise. Kinetix never stores your card data.

items.q: What sizes and brands are available?
items.a: Running shoes from Nike, Adidas, and On Running in EU sizes 36–47. Over 180 pairs in Men, Women, and Unisex categories.

items.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
items.body: By registering or using Kinetix shoe rental services, you accept all terms of service. If you do not accept, please do not use the service.

items.title: 2. User Eligibility
items.body: Must be 20 years or older, or have parental consent. · Must provide a valid delivery address. · Must provide correct bank account information for deposit refunds.

items.title: 3. Ordering and Cancellation
items.body: Orders are confirmed when Omise reports successful payment. · Cancellations accepted only before 23:59 on the order date for a full refund. · After 23:59 cancellations are not possible as items are packed.

items.title: 4. Delivery and Receipt
items.body: Kinetix delivers the next day (D+1) before noon, every day including holidays. · Rental period starts from 12:00 PM on the delivery date. · Refusing delivery 3+ times may result in temporary account suspension.

items.title: 5. Returning Shoes
items.body: Press Notify Return in the app before 12:00 PM on the due date, or within Grace Period 1:00 PM. · The time you press notify determines Late/On-time status. · Driver will pick up from your address.

items.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
items.body: Kinetix is not liable for delays due to force majeure. · Not liable for injuries from wearing shoes. · Using shoes for unintended purposes constitutes a breach of contract.
